title: Mobile Demonstrator List
description: Touch-only vertical snap list for the demonstrator landing with scroll-driven veil tint.
summary:
## Summary
Implemented touch-only mobile mode for the Entwerfen mit Bestand demonstrator landing: six full-viewport snap sections in a vertical list, live app pane behind each card, scroll-driven `ui-veil` opacity (clear when settled, tinted between sections), lazy pane boot on scroll, and focus/return with scroll lock.

### Changes
- `DEMONSTRATOR_TOUCH_LIST_MEDIA_QUERY` = max-width 767px + hover:none + pointer:coarse; landing surface chrome uses `mobile` when `UI_MOBILE_MEDIA_QUERY` matches.
- `DemonstratorCard` shared by desktop grid and mobile list.
- `useSequentialPaneBoot({ skipIdleQueue })` for list mode; promote current + next section on scroll.
- Desktop grid unchanged behind `touchListMode` guard on mouse/easing/reveal effects.

### Verification
- Playwright iPhone 14: 6 sections, snap container, veil opacity 0 on first pane, scroll stack offsets 0..3320, tap focus `#generator`, Übersicht clears hash; desktop still uses 3×2 grid (0 sections).
- `SKIP_PLUGIN_BUILD=1 bun ./📜️script.ts build` failed on pre-existing vite worker path (unrelated to this change).
